body: The agent door from #1012 answers one tool. This PR gives each agent a connection the owner can revoke, puts every policy check in one dispatcher, and adds the read operations an agent needs before any write ships. It is Agent access 2 (WIL-3544) of the agent-access design. It builds on the WorkOS spike, which passed on staging on 2026-10-05. ## What changes - **Migration `0042_agent_access.sql`** (0041 is claimed by two open PRs). It adds `agent_connections`, `agent_actions`, `agent_approvals` and a `jobs` index for the later daily cap. Row types are regenerated. - **Connections.** - One row per WorkOS user and OAuth client. The token must carry `client_id`; the spike saw it on every host, so there is no `azp` path. - A revoked connection stays refused even with a refreshed token. - After any revoke, a client the owner hasn't seen lands `pending` until the owner enables it. ChatGPT and Codex mint per-install client ids, so re-adding a connector otherwise slips past a revoke. - Ten connections per user at most. `last_used_at` is stamped at most once a minute. - **One dispatcher** (`agent/dispatch.ts`), in order: - permission; - a rate limit per connection (standard tier for reads, writes and retracts; strict for spend, publish and destroy); - entitlement for writes through `readWindowTrialOfferWithStripeSync`, with a 5-minute walled cache, answering 503 when it can't be read; - replay scoped to operation and target, matching only successful rows, with server-minted ids; - the operation; - an audit row for every write. Only reads ship here. The write path is proven by tests over a test-only operation. - **Read operations.** - `library_list`, projected with no raw metadata. - `videos_get`, which waits up to 45 s and asks Mux on the first and last poll only. - `pages_get`, with the document marked untrusted. - `pages_stats`, sharing the route's lifted body. - `pages_leads` and `contacts_list`, both behind the per-connection `leads_contacts` permission, which starts off. Prospect text is marked untrusted, and contacts are owner-only. - `approvals_get`. - `whoami` now includes the connection. - **Owner API under the session cookie.** `GET /api/agent/connections`, `POST /:id/revoke` (a wall exit), `POST /:id/enable`, `PATCH /:id { leadsContacts }`. Impersonated sessions are refused on every write. - **A 90-day sweep** of `agent_actions` on the minute cron. - **Docs:** CONTEXT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DEPLOY.md, SECURITY.md. Bundle: +10.1 KB gzip (+2.2%). ## Before merge This is an auth policy change, routed **steer**. The migration makes the merge a stack deploy, so list pending production migrations first. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith with what you need. Autofix is disabled. ## Proof **Issue:** WIL-3544 · **Routing:** steer (auth policy change) **Ticket proof:** https://linear.app/cocco/issue/WIL-3544/agent-access-2-connections-audit-policy-dispatcher-read-operations#comment-7e80db66 **Verified head:** `fceecd7f3` (preview `/__deploy-info` headSha `fceecd7f33f83fe8b8ef847ebf90850d43c8147c`) **Preview:** https://pr-1024.clarity-video.workers.dev **Repro:** `node scripts/agent-mcp.mjs conformance --base https://pr-1024.clarity-video.workers.dev --key --sub `, plus the owner-API sequence in the ticket proof. **Before:** main's door has no connections, no revocation, no read tools: `tools/list` names only `whoami`. **After:** conformance 13/13 on the preview. Independent verifier VERIFIED, with every acceptance item exercised on the preview database: - revoke, then a refreshed token is 403 `connection_revoked`; - an unseen client after a revoke is 403 `connection_pending`; - the eleventh client is 403 `too_many_connections`, and re-enabling at the cap is 409; - the leads permission gates `pages_leads` and `contacts_list`; - the owner API answers 401 without a cookie, 403 for a foreign Origin, and 404 for another user's id; - 0042's tables exist and reads write no audit rows. **Red→green tests:** - `agent-mcp-door.test.ts` "revoke A, re-enable A, unseen B lands pending" fails on `a793762b9` and passes on head. - `agent-dispatch.test.ts` Stripe 503 and 404 cases, and `agent-connections-api.test.ts` "re-enable at the live cap is 409", both fail before their fix commits. **Verify report:** `.context/verify-loop/20261005T235822Z/independent/REPORT.md` (VERIFIED) **Production migrations pending** (`wrangler d1 migrations list`, 2026-10-06 00:14 UTC): AUTH_DB `0042_agent_access.sql` only; VIDEO_STATS_DB and AUTH_EMAIL_DB none. The merge is a stack deploy that applies just this one. **Waved through:** `connections-api.ts` builds its `SET` clause from three literal callers (reviewer nit, out of scope). `clientName` is stored null: the CIMD document fetch is deferred to the Settings PR. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
